Delhi High Court SPA Typing Test Exam City Details 2026 – Full Details

High Court of Delhi (DHC) has released the Typing Test Exam City Details for the post of Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) & Personal Assistant (PA). This recruitment was released for 150 posts. Applications for the Delhi High Court SPA & PA Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 15 September 2026, to 05 October 2026. The SPA Examination is going to Conducted on 14 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Delhi High Court SPA Typing Test Exam City Details 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 05 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 15 September 2026
  • Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Correction Window : 12 October 2026
  • SPA Exam Date : 14 November 2026
  • PA Exam Date : 27 November 2026
  • SPA Exam City Details : 06 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, BC, Female : Rs. 1300/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
